propositions: pip-audit gate fails on every patchset on main due to click 8.2.1 vulnerability PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit), blocking Verified +1 votes
click 8.2.1 cannot be upgraded to 8.3.3+ while inspect-ai is a dependency, because inspect-ai caps click to <8.2.2 and all extras are resolved jointly by uv
click.edit() vulnerable code path is unreachable in rebar (never imported), making the advisory inapplicable to this project
override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"] in pyproject.toml resolves the lock satisfiably to click 8.4.2 and is safe because the cap is stale across all inspect-ai releases
fix landed on main via override-dependencies approach, resolving the blocking pip-audit failure
